howto: Your yellow ball walks along a plank that keeps tilting.
Tap, click or press Space to turn the ball around.
A pulsing yellow line marks the plank's low edge: if the ball walks past it, you fall off.
Stay on until the bar at the bottom fills (100%).
tips: Turn early: once the ball is past the yellow line there is no saving it.
The tilt swings back on its own at the ends, so the safe side changes: watch which way the line is moving.
Red shading at both ends means the plank is steep; expect the line to race.
The eyes show which way the ball is walking.

controls.keyboard: Space to start and to turn around. P or Esc pauses.
controls.touch: Tap anywhere to turn around. Pause button top right.

difficulty: Easy, Normal and Hard on the title screen set how fast the plank tilts. Your best is the furthest percentage you have balanced.

cheats.effect: The plank tilts at half speed
Your ball walks at half speed
12 px of extra room past the edge line before you fall

features.one-tap-start: Tap anywhere or press Space on the title card
features.instant-restart: Tap once on the FELL OFF! or BALANCED! card
features.best-score-badge: BEST % under the progress readout at the top
features.tutorial-card: First-run How to play card inside the title screen; replay from Pause > How to play
features.results: FELL OFF! card with the percentage balanced and your best
features.progression: Player level + XP bar, coins, stars, a date-seeded daily challenge (10-coin bonus), milestone achievements and 4 unlockable skins bought with coins (sky-PK-balance-tile blob; HUD + title card visible without menus)
